question_text:
6.
A company has sales of ` 6,00,000, variable cost of ` 2,40,000, fixed
operating cost of ` 2,70,000. The financial leverage is 2.5. The company
wants to double its EBIT. The percentage change in ales required in order
to double its EBIT will be :
(A)
50%

(B)
25%
(C)
40%
(D)
80%
